blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
You just met the idea. Now do the lab: Three booklet breaks.

This lab can fail. Fail when: You cannot explain one error, or you leave the check copy broken.

Expected: Check copy completeness clean. Three one-line repairs.

blocks.lead: Walk the cards below, in order, to Three booklet breaks.
blocks.intro: How to Three booklet breaks. Walk the cards in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Three booklet breaks
steps.body: This is the whole move. The next cards are the steps, in order.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Copy flower-docs to oxygen-bootcamp-work/week3-check/ so you do not wreck the sample.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Break 1: rename a page file without updating the booklet. Run completeness. Repair.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Break 2: delete a closing tag on one page. Read the well-formed error. Undo.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Break 3: add a pointer to a file you never created. Read the row. Remove the pointer or add the file.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: Pass the quiz. Week 4 stays locked until this day is finished.
